description: This file defines a Configuration class for managing 'use dual stack endpoint' settings in the AWS SDK PHP, including validation and conversion to array.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Class for configuring and validating the use of dual stack endpoints within AWS SDK PHP.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Configuration object, validates the 'useDualstackEndpoint' boolean, and ensures it's not used in ISO regions.

methods.name: isUseDualstackEndpoint
methods.description: Returns whether dual stack endpoint usage is enabled.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
